title: Amazon Shop Direct: Why Product Data at the Source Matters More Than Optimizing for Amazon
summary: Amazon Shop Direct lists products from brand sites and feeds. See how Amazon gets the data, what changed in 2026, and why one complete source record matters.
body_markdown:
Amazon Shop Direct puts products from brands' own websites into Amazon search when Amazon's store does not sell the item. For eligible products, Amazon's Buy for Me agent places the order on the brand's site. In both cases, Amazon builds the listing from data it reads on your website or receives in your feed.


That makes your source product record the thing to get right. Build one complete record, enrich it once, and map it to each channel's fields. That one record serves Shop Direct and every other channel that reads your site or feeds.


This guide covers what Shop Direct is, how Amazon gets its data, what changed in 2026, and how to join, correct or leave the program.


## What is Shop Direct, and how is it different from selling on Amazon?


Shop Direct is Amazon's program for showing products that its own store does not currently sell. Amazon's[March 2026 update on Shop Direct and Buy for Me](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-shop-direct-external-stores) says these products can appear in Amazon search with a Shop Direct label. A shopper who taps through sees a notice that they are leaving Amazon, then lands on the merchant's website.


Buy for Me works differently. For eligible products, the shopper taps Buy for Me and confirms the delivery address, taxes, shipping fees and payment method on Amazon. Amazon's AI then completes the purchase on the merchant's website. According to Amazon's[November 2026 Merchant Workspace announcement](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-shop-direct-merchant-workspace) , the merchant handles shipping, delivery, returns, exchanges and customer service through its existing processes.


Selling on Amazon puts your product in Amazon's own store, with checkout on Amazon. Shop Direct covers items outside that store. Checkout stays on your site, or Buy for Me places the order there for you. Your own fulfillment and support handle every order that arrives this way.


### Shop Direct changes by date


- **January 6, 2026.**[CNBC reported pushback from online retailers](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/01/06/amazons-ai-shopping-tool-sparks-backlash-from-some-online-retailers.html) who said Amazon had listed their products without their consent. Some said listings showed items they had never sold or that were out of stock. Amazon told CNBC that Buy for Me was an experiment and that it takes no commission on those purchases.
- **March 11, 2026.** Amazon opened Shop Direct to merchant product feeds through participating syndicators. It said the program covered more than 100 million products from over 400,000 merchants. Amazon also said a merchant portal was coming soon. Its list of surfaces included Amazon.com, the Amazon Shopping app, mobile web and[Amazon Rufus](https://www.hypotenuse.ai/blog/amazon-rufus-review) .
- **November 4, 2026.** Amazon launched the Shop Direct Merchant Workspace, a free self-service portal. Amazon said Shop Direct is available to all US customers and appears in hundreds of millions of searches each month. Its November list of surfaces names Alexa for Shopping, not Rufus.


## How does Amazon get the product data it shows?


Amazon uses two sources: your public website and a product feed you send. The two give you different levels of control.


**Website sourcing.** In January 2026, Amazon told CNBC that Shop Direct takes product and pricing details from public information on brand websites. It also said its system checks that the item is in stock and the price is correct. For a brand that has not shared a feed, the listing reflects what Amazon reads on your live product pages, including any errors on them.


**Feed sourcing.** Since March 2026, merchants can send a product feed instead. Amazon says feeds sync catalog, pricing and inventory with Shop Direct in real time. The November Merchant Workspace accepts widely used shopping feed formats, so brands can reuse feeds they already build for other channels. A feed lets you decide which products to send and which values fill each field.


These two sources need to agree. A feed that says one thing and a product page that says another gives Amazon conflicting facts. The same applies to[product data for AI shopping agents](https://www.hypotenuse.ai/blog/product-data-for-ai-shopping-agents) generally: generate the feed, the product page and the on-page structured data from one product record.


## If you already sell on Amazon, does Shop Direct mean more competition?


Amazon describes Shop Direct as a way to show products its store does not currently sell. That makes it a gap-filler. It adds items from other stores where Amazon's own catalog has nothing to offer the shopper. Amazon has not published how Shop Direct listings rank or where they appear next to products sold in its store.


The direct effect for an existing Amazon seller is narrower than head-to-head rivalry in main search. A competitor that sells only on its own website can now appear in Amazon search for an item Amazon's store does not carry. If you sell part of your range on Amazon, the rest of your range can reach Amazon shoppers the same way.


Amazon's November announcement asks existing Amazon sellers who want to take part in Shop Direct to contactshopdirect@amazon.com . The listing for any of those products will be built from the same source data as your other channels.


## Do you need to optimize for Amazon Shop Direct?


Not as a separate program. Shop Direct builds each listing from your website or your feed, so the work is on the product record those two draw from. A complete source record also covers the wider product catalog Amazon may be planning.


### What Shop Direct needs from your product data


Amazon hasn't published a checklist for Shop Direct listings. It does say where the data comes from: your live product pages, or the feed you send. A gap or error in either one shows up in the listing.


### What Amazon's reported World Product Graph would add


A leaked internal document points to a wider goal. On November 13, 2026,[Reuters reported on an internal Amazon document](https://www.reuters.com/business/media-telecom/amazons-plan-own-worlds-product-data-fight-ai-shopping-agents-2026-11-13/) describing a "World Product Graph."


The document gives an aspirational date of October 1, 2027. Amazon told Reuters that draft, outdated documents often paint an incomplete picture, and that the existence of a brainstorming document of this kind does not necessarily reflect its current plans. Treat it as unconfirmed.


### Why one source record covers Amazon and other catalogs


Amazon is not the only company building a product catalog that brands feed. Shopify says eligible products are discoverable through Shopify Catalog by AI channels including ChatGPT and Microsoft Copilot.


Each of these catalogs reads the same underlying facts about your products. A separate "optimize for Amazon" program repeats that work for one channel. Enrich the source record once, then tailor what each channel receives.


## Why would a brand still sell on Amazon, not only use Shop Direct?


The main advantage is Amazon's own delivery and checkout. Prime-eligible store listings come with Amazon's delivery promise, while Shop Direct orders go out on your own shipping terms.


### What selling in Amazon's store gives you


Amazon says its store offers fast, free Prime delivery on 300 million items. Prime members see that delivery promise on Prime-eligible products, for example through Fulfillment by Amazon, and check out on Amazon. Amazon also points store sellers to Amazon Ads.


### What Shop Direct gives you


Shop Direct reaches Amazon shoppers for items Amazon's store does not carry, and Amazon says there are no fees to take part. Your own shipping and returns apply to every order. For Buy for Me orders, the shopper sees your shipping fees before confirming.


### Using both routes


Selling in the store and joining Shop Direct can run side by side. A brand can sell part of its range in Amazon's store and let Shop Direct reach Amazon shoppers for the rest.


## Which product data should stay consistent across channels, and what should you tailor per channel?


Shop Direct is one more sales channel reading your product data, alongside Google, Walmart, Target and your own site. Keep the product facts the same on every channel, and tailor how each channel receives them.


### Keep product facts the same on every channel


Identifiers, variant structure, dimensions, materials, compatibility, price and availability describe the product itself. They belong in one source record that every channel reads from.


### Tailor field names, formats and attributes per channel


Each channel receives those facts in its own format, with its own field names, allowed values, title formats and category-specific attributes. Amazon, Walmart, Google and Target each set different[product attributes by channel](https://www.hypotenuse.ai/blog/product-attributes-by-channel) , so map each channel's fields from one master record.


### Where channel mapping stops and enrichment starts


Platforms now support this split. Shopify's October 28, 2026 channel mapping update added a page for managing the product data sent to each sales channel. Merchants can change a field's source, combine sources and override values per product and channel. It also shows how many products have a value for each field.


[Shopify channel mapping](https://www.hypotenuse.ai/blog/shopify-channel-mapping) chooses which stored field fills which channel field. It cannot supply a material, a dimension or a compatibility value that your record does not hold. Enrichment fills the record. Mapping then shapes it per channel.


## How do you join, correct or leave Shop Direct today?


Amazon changed the process twice in 2026. In March, brands joined through participating feed syndicators. Since November 4, 2026, they can also join through the Merchant Workspace. The steps below follow Amazon's pages as of November 2026.


### Join through the Merchant Workspace


The Workspace is free and self-service. Merchants create a Shop Direct merchant account, verify their business website, then share their catalog through a solution provider or directly through Amazon's Selling Partner API. The Workspace shows which products are active and available to shoppers through Shop Direct. Existing Amazon sellers contactshopdirect@amazon.com .


### Correct product details


Amazon's public pages do not describe a separate form for correcting Shop Direct listings. With a feed, update the value or remove the item in your feed, then check the Workspace for which products are active. Without a feed, correct the live product page, since that is the public data Amazon reads.


### Leave the program


Amazon's November announcement says merchants can opt out at any time, and the Workspace lets merchants manage their participation. Amazon's March update also points merchants to the[Shop Direct merchant page](https://shopdirect.amazon.com/) for opt-out details.


That page's FAQ says merchants who do not want their website to take part can contactshopdirect@amazon.com , and that Amazon will respond within two business days. After opting out, search the Amazon Shopping app for your brand to confirm the listings are gone.


## How do you get product data ready for Amazon Shop Direct?


Get your product data ready and optimized. Search engines and AI shopping agents find products through the data on your pages and in your feeds, so complete, consistent attributes help your products show up for the right searches.


Shop Direct listings appear in Amazon search, so an attribute missing on your page or in your feed is missing from the Amazon listing too. Optimize the source record once, then generate the feed and the product page from it so the two agree.

## Frequently asked questions


### What is Amazon Buy for Me?


Buy for Me is an Amazon AI agent that buys eligible Shop Direct products on the brand's website for the shopper. The shopper confirms address, taxes, shipping and payment on Amazon. The brand receives the order and handles shipping, returns, exchanges and customer service.


### Can a brand appear in Shop Direct without signing up?


Yes. In January 2026, retailers told CNBC that their products appeared without their consent, and Amazon said it takes product and pricing details from public brand websites. Brands that join through the Merchant Workspace or a feed provider control which products they send.


### Does Amazon charge brands for Shop Direct?


Amazon's November 2026 announcement says there are no fees to take part in Shop Direct. Separately, CNBC reported in January 2026 that Amazon said it takes no commission on Buy for Me purchases.


### Can brands that already sell on Amazon join Shop Direct?


Amazon's November 2026 announcement asks Amazon sellers interested in Shop Direct to contactshopdirect@amazon.com . Amazon has not published separate eligibility rules for existing sellers on the pages reviewed for this guide.
